results.body:
new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/chaos"),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("chaos")
.withChaos(
        HttpChaosProfile.httpChaosProfile()
                .withErrorStatus(503)
                .withRetryAfter("5")
                .withErrorProbability(0.25)
                .withLatency(new Delay(TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS, 5))
                .withSeed(42L)
                .withSucceedFirst(1)
                .withOutageAfterMillis(1000L)
                .withMalformedBody(true)
                .withQuotaName("q")
                .withQuotaLimit(3)
                .withQuotaWindowMillis(60000L)
)
.withCapture(
        CaptureRule.captureRule()
                .withSource(org.mockserver.model.CaptureRule.Source.jsonPath)
                .withExpression("$.id")
                .withInto("orderId"),
        CaptureRule.captureRule()
                .withSource(org.mockserver.model.CaptureRule.Source.header)
                .withExpression("X-Trace")
                .withInto("trace")
)
.withCrossProtocolScenarios(java.util.Arrays.asList(
        CrossProtocolScenario.crossProtocolScenario()
                .withTrigger(org.mockserver.model.CrossProtocolTrigger.HTTP_REQUEST)
                .withScenarioName("Flow")
                .withTargetState("Connected")
                .withMatchPattern("/chaos")
))
.withBeforeActions(
        AfterAction.afterAction()
                .withHttpRequest(
                        request()
                                .withMethod("POST")
                                .withPath("/hook/before")
                )
                .withBlocking(true)
                .withTimeout(new Delay(TimeUnit.SECONDS, 2))
                .withFailurePolicy(org.mockserver.model.FailurePolicy.BEST_EFFORT)
)
.withAfterActions(
        AfterAction.afterAction()
                .withHttpRequest(
                        request()
                                .withPath("/hook/after")
                )
                .withDelay(new Delay(TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS, 10))
)
.respond(
        response()
                .withStatusCode(200)
                .withBody("ok")
);

new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.upsert(
        new org.mockserver.mock.Expectation(
                request()
                        .withPath("/rate"),
                Times.unlimited(),
                TimeToLive.unlimited(),
                0
        )
        .withId("rate")
        .withRateLimit(
                RateLimit.rateLimit()
                        .withName("r")
                        .withAlgorithm(org.mockserver.model.RateLimit.Algorithm.TOKEN_BUCKET)

                        .withRetryAfter("1")
        )
        .thenRespond(
                response()
                        .withBody("limited")
        )
);

.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/ws"),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("ws")
.respondWithWebSocket(
        HttpWebSocketResponse.webSocketResponse()
                .withSubprotocol("chat")
                .withMessages(
                        WebSocketMessage.webSocketMessage()
                                .withText("hi"),
                        WebSocketMessage.webSocketMessage()
                                .withBinary(java.util.Base64.getDecoder().decode("AAEC"))

                        WebSocketMessageMatcher.webSocketMessageMatcher()
                                .withTextMatcher(NottableString.string("ping", false))
                                .withFrameType(org.mockserver.model.WebSocketFrameType.TEXT)
                                .withResponses(
                                        WebSocketMessage.webSocketMessage()
                                                .withText("pong")
                                ),
                        WebSocketMessageMatcher.webSocketMessageMatcher()
                                .withFrameType(org.mockserver.model.WebSocketFrameType.BINARY)
                                .withResponses(
                                ),
                        WebSocketMessageMatcher.webSocketMessageMatcher()
                                .withFrameType(org.mockserver.model.WebSocketFrameType.ANY)
                )
                .withCloseConnection(false)
);

new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/v1/messages"),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("llm")
.respondWithLlm(
        HttpLlmResponse.llmResponse()
                .withProvider(org.mockserver.model.Provider.ANTHROPIC)
                .withModel("m")
                .withCompletion(
                        Completion.completion()
                                .withText("hi")
                                .withToolCalls(
                                        ToolUse.toolUse("t")
                                                .withId("c1")
                                                .withArguments("{}")
                                )
                                .withStopReason("end_turn")
                                .withUsage(
                                        Usage.usage()
                                                .withInputTokens(3)
                                                .withOutputTokens(1)
                                )
                                .withStreaming(true)
                )
                .withConversationPredicates(
                        ConversationPredicates.conversationPredicates()
                                .withTurnIndex(1)
                                .withLatestMessageRole(org.mockserver.llm.ParsedMessage.Role.USER)
                                .withNormalization(
                                        NormalizationOptions.normalizationOptions()
                                                .withLowercase(true)
                                                .withDropVolatileFields(java.util.Arrays.asList("ts"))
                                )
                )
                .withChaos(
                        LlmChaosProfile.llmChaosProfile()
                                .withErrorStatus(529)
                                .withErrorProbability(0.5)
                                .withTruncateMode(org.mockserver.model.LlmChaosProfile.TruncateMode.MID_STREAM)
                                .withTokenQuotaLimit(100L)
                )
);
